# OpenSearch Service

[API index](index.md) | [Definition schema](schema.md)

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `docker.opensearch` |
| Source | `09_docker/opensearch.yaml` |
| Tags | docker, search |

OpenSearch single-node cluster with the security plugin disabled for local
development. Backs full-text search workloads in the content graph stack.

| `DATA_PATH` | `string` | yes | `-` | Host path for OpenSearch indices (binds to /usr/share/opensearch/data in container) |
| `OPENSEARCH_INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | `string` | yes | `-` | Initial password for the OpenSearch admin user |
| `OPENSEARCH_PORT` | `string` | no | `9200` | Host port to expose the OpenSearch HTTP API (default 9200) |
| `OPENSEARCH_PERF_PORT` | `string` | no | `9600` | Host port for the OpenSearch performance analyzer (default 9600) |
